pkg.summary: I hold the glow so you don't fall.
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, gentle glowing atmosphere)

Lost in dark… but I’m here…
Your light… I’ll be near…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Lost in darkness, no stars above
Only faint shadows, holding your love
When the road disappears

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

Take my hand, I won’t let you fall
I’ll be the flame through it all

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

I’ll be your light… on the way
Never fade… guiding you
Steady glow… through the blue
I’ll be your lantern… for you

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

I’ll be your light… on the way
Never fade… guiding you
Steady glow… through the blue
I’ll be your lantern… for you

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

Cold wind cuts across your face
End of the road you can’t trace
Even hope feels far away

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

Listen close, hear my voice
I’m right here, you have a choice

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

I’ll be your light… on the way
Never fade… guiding you
Steady glow… through the blue
I’ll be your lantern… for you

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

I’ll be your light… on the way
Never fade… guiding you
Steady glow… through the blue
I’ll be your lantern… for you

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

Let me shine… over you…
Hold on tight… I got you…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

Dark tried to swallow but I’m the spark
Your shaky steps meet my steady heart
No more hiding, no more fear
My light stays close, always near
One hand, one glow, we move slow
Through the night where the cold winds blow
Yeah… I’ll be your light…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

I’ll be your light… on the way
Never fade… guiding you
Steady glow… through the blue
I’ll be your lantern… for you

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

I’ll be your light… forever… true…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.

pkg.youtubeDescription:
🌙 A quiet night track about staying as soft steady light when someone loses the road.

💭 Spoken close and low, it holds the shake without raising the voice—just presence locked to the beat.

🎧 Groovy Airy POP: airy electro-pop groove, raspy female spoken cadence, 92 BPM behind-the-beat feel.

💬 If this glow caught you tonight, tell me where you needed the light. Comment your night below.
